mapper.select: SELECT pr.*, (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name) AS employee_name, e.employee_code, u.display_name AS reviewer_name FROM employee_profile_requests pr INNER JOIN employees e ON e.id = pr.employee_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = pr.reviewer_id WHERE pr.id = #{id} AND pr.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_profile_requests ( company_id, employee_id, request_type, field_name, current_value, requested_value, reason, status ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{requestType}, #{fieldName}, #{currentValue}, #{requestedValue}, #{reason}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_profile_requests SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewer_notes = #{reviewerNotes}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId}
